<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$report = array();
$report[] = 'stylesheet=' . get_option('stylesheet');
$report[] = 'demo_flag=' . (get_option('maison_calista_demo_installed') ? '1' : '0');
$report[] = 'front=' . get_option('page_on_front');
$report[] = 'show_on_front=' . get_option('show_on_front');
$pages = get_posts(array('post_type'=>'page','numberposts'=>-1,'post_status'=>'any'));
$report[] = 'page_count=' . count($pages);
foreach ($pages as $p) { $report[] = 'page:' . $p->post_name . '|' . $p->post_title; }
$report[] = 'fn_exists=' . (function_exists('maison_calista_install_demo_content') ? '1' : '0');
$report[] = 'setup_error=' . (string) get_transient('maison_calista_setup_error');
$report[] = 'theme_switched=' . var_export(get_option('theme_switched'), true);
$locations = get_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', array());
$report[] = 'menu_primary=' . (isset($locations['primary']) ? $locations['primary'] : '0');
@mkdir('/output', 0777, true);
file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', implode("\n", $report));
echo implode("\n", $report);
